//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> GUI Compass -> Config

Enable GUI Compass.//: Whether GUI Compass is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

guiCompassFormat.//: What of the GUI compass should be displayed. Default: [FXYZ]. F: facing (direction), X: x coord, Y: y coord (depth), Z: z coord.

mustHaveCompassInInventory.//: When enabled, will only show the GUI compass when a compass is present in the inventory.

compassPosition.//: Where the compass is shown at the top of the screen. options: Left, Center, Right

compassHeightOffset.//: The vertical offset (y coord) for the Compass. This determines how far down the time should be on the screen. Can be changed to prevent GUIs from overlapping. min: 0, max: 3,000

drawTextShadow.//: If the text displayed should have a shadow drawn below it.

RGB.//: The colour of the compass text, as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.
